question: Which celebrity breakup story just got called out by the ex?
story: Jerry O'Connell reportedly dumped Giuliana Rancic through an apartment intercom, and twenty two years later she is finally clapping back. The two dated back in two thousand three. This week O'Connell went public about the split, calling himself a terrible boyfriend and saying Giuliana turned up at his condo unannounced. According to her own memoir, what happened next was that he spoke to her through the building intercom and said, things change, but you take care. And that was it. Relationship over. Through a speaker. Giuliana saw his version of events and posted a video saying his memory is, quote, a little fuzzy. She added that she could easily do a forty minute podcast episode on this instead of a short statement. Then she invited him onto her podcast to say it to her face. Jerry, you are so invited, she said. Somebody get that man a microphone. Just maybe not an intercom.
